verses.1: Bel Keris Nebo’s people were in great sorrow. Their livestock was also in distress; they were forced to carry their loads on their backs, exhausted from the journey.
verses.2: They fell together; they couldn’t lift anything. Their souls went into the depths of despair.
verses.3: Hear me, house of Jacob! And all the rest of the house of Israel, who are burdened by the sins they have committed.
verses.4: And until death, I will remain that person. And until restoration, I will continue to act as I did before. I will continue to do what I have done, and I will continue to exist.
verses.5: To whom shall I be compared? To whom shall I be measured and judged?
verses.6: They will take gold from their purses and silver from their bags. They will buy it, make it into something useful, and then worship it. They will not bow down or worship it at all.
verses.7: He will carry him on his shoulders, suffer for him, and place him under his feet. He will stand by his side, never crying out or responding to his suffering. He will not save him.
verses.8: Remember this, and let them be punished. The wicked will be brought back to their rightful place.
verses.9: Remember our ancestors from the past. I am God, and there is no other god besides Me. I am the One who created everything.
verses.10: I will speak from the beginning to the end, and from what was done in the past. My advice will be carried out, and all my desires will be fulfilled.
verses.11: I read from the east, from a distant land. I give advice to others; I speak words of wisdom. I create things, and I also destroy them.
verses.12: Hear me, O lords of the hearts that are far from righteousness.
verses.13: I have committed to righteousness; it will not be withdrawn from me. My help will never be removed from me. I have given Israel relief in Zion. My kindness will never be taken away from them.
